description: Fast deterministic world pack lookup. Use for finding monsters, NPCs, locations, items, etc. Automatically detects entity type and does fuzzy name matching. Pure function lookup (~5ms) with no LLM overhead.

entityType.description: Entity type hint (optional, will auto-detect if not provided)

includeSecrets.description: Whether to include GM-only information (default: true)

query.description: Search query - can be entity name, ID, or natural language

name: quick_research
